title: zanity.toml
description: Settings for zanity check: which rules run, which files are skipped, and which model --infer asks.

rules.description: Run only these rules instead of the defaults. "all" is every rule, including those off by default. --rules on the command line overrides it.

disable.description: Rules to leave out of the selection, such as ["duplicate-name"].

exclude.description: Paths to skip, in .gitignore syntax, relative to this file, such as ["vendor/", "tests/fixtures/**"].

infer.description: Which System One server check --infer asks, and how hard.

url.description: The System One server to ask, such as a local Kev. Defaults to TYPESAFE_BASE_URL, then TypeSafe's API.

model.description: The model to ask. Defaults to TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL, then jev-latest.

api_key_env.description: The environment variable holding the API key, which only TypeSafe's API requires. Defaults to TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

concurrency.description: Requests sent to the model at once.

threshold.description: How sure the model must be for a judgement to become a finding: 0.9 reports only what it is at least 90% sure of, and a lower value reports more.

paths.description: Rules that don't report in some files, one table per pattern, such as [paths."tests/e2e/"]. Patterns are .gitignore syntax, relative to this file.

disable.description: Rules that don't report in the files this pattern matches.

vocabulary.description: The project's words for things: names using a banned word, or an alias of the word the project settled on, are reported.

forbidden.description: Words no name may use, such as ["util", "manager"].

directional.description: Words that give a name a direction, so us_to_uk and uk_to_us aren't name drift.

domains.description: Parts of the code with words of their own, such as [domains.commerce]; contexts apply after them.

contexts.description: Bounded contexts with words of their own, such as [contexts.billing]; they apply after domains, and each may define its own Customer.

synonyms.description: The canonical word = the aliases it replaces, such as customer = ["client", "user"].

include.description: The files it covers, in .gitignore syntax, relative to this file.

forbidden.description: Words no name in it may use.

anyOf.description: Every rule, including those off by default.
